ङ: ङ The fifth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, and the nasal of the first class; the sound of this letter corresponds with that of the nasal N in Song, &c. or in the French word bon.
ङ m. (ङः) 1 An object of sense. 2 Desire, wish for any sensual object. E. ङु to sound, affix ङ.
ङु: ङु (ङु) r. 1st cl. (ङवते) To sound. च
